# Montessori Minds (La Casa Verde by Montessori Minds)
> Montessori school, nursery and pre-school in Choueifat, Lebanon for children from infancy through age six.

Montessori Minds operates La Casa Verde on Saida Old Road, Al Omara District, Choueifat, Mount Lebanon. We offer Montessori Infant Community / Nido (birth–18 months), Toddler Community (18 months–3 years), and Children's House pre-school (ages 3–6). Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM. Phone: +961 71 007 150. Email: hello@montessorimindslb.com.

## What we offer
- Prepared Montessori classrooms with Guides who observe before they intervene
- Nursery pathways for infants and toddlers; Children's House for ages 3–6
- Arabic, English and French in daily classroom life
- Campus visits for families comparing early childhood options near Choueifat, Beirut and Baabda
